name: Boss HM-2 Heavy Metal
description: Boss HM-2 Heavy Metal (1983) as drawn in the Roland service notes (first edition, 15 Dec 1983; the Hobby Hour PNG is a crop of the same sheet). Signal path: 2SK30A source-follower input buffer -> 2SK30A bypass switch Q4 (ON in the effect state) -> 2SC2240 booster Q6 (470k/100p collector-base feedback) -> 2SA970 PNP stage Q7 (R26 100k / R29 470k bias, collector straight into IC1b +) -> M5218L clipping amplifier IC1b with D3 one way and D4+D5 the other in its 220k/100p feedback and a 47n + 47k gain leg to DIST. DIST (VR4 250k, wiper grounded) sets both IC1b's gain leg (lug 3) and a 150 ohm + 10 uF shunt on Q6's collector (lug 1), so at 0 the pedal is quiet and cleaner, never silent. Then C12 / R23 / a series antiparallel D6-D7 pair / R30 / D8-D9 + 1n to ground -> IC1a buffer -> R54 3.3k into IC3a (non-inverting, R52 3.3k || 470p). COLOR MIX: VR2 (L) and VR3 (H), 10k each, both span IC3a's + and - inputs, their wipers feeding series gyrator resonators to AC ground: VR2 -> 87 Hz (1.5u, 330/100k/0.068u); VR3 -> 958 Hz (0.15u, 330/82k/6.8n) and 1278 Hz (0.1u, 330/100k/4.7n); clockwise boosts the band, counter-clockwise cuts it. -> LEVEL 10kA -> Q10 output switch (ON) -> 2SC945 emitter follower. Rebuilt to the drawing 2026-11-12 (VERIFY_BATCH_1 #6, CONTROL_AUDIT_FX 2.3/2.4): the DIST pot had been a volume control after the clipper (silent at 0), the gyrators were driven as band-pass sources whose outputs both COLOR MIX wipers shared, D4/D5 and D6/D7 were in the wrong place/direction, R10 was missing, Q7's bias and the IC1b + coupling had been re-invented, and Q10 was a source follower. The NORMAL/EFFECT FETs' logic (Q2/Q5/Q8/Q9), the CHECK LED and the battery protection are omitted: only the effect-on path is modelled.

sources.title: Boss HM-2 Service Notes, First Edition (Roland, Dec 15 1983): full circuit diagram, parts list (M5218L, 2SK30A-Y, 2SC2240-GR, 2SA970-GR, 2SC945-P, 1S2473, 1S188FM, S5500) and the waveform-check frequency table fL 90+/-10 Hz, fH1 950+/-50 Hz, fH2 1.3k+/-200 Hz
Hobby Hour redrawn Boss HM-2 schematic (single page, same circuit, used to cross-read the volume-board gyrators and the COLOR MIX wiring)
Muzique, 'Gyrators' bandpass EQ calculator: L = R1*R2*C2, f0 = 1/(2*pi*sqrt(L*C1)) - the relation used to check the three tone bands against the service-notes frequencies

controls.label: Distortion
controls.note: VR4 250 kOhm D-taper (Boss 'D' law; modelled with the reverse-log C law). Wiper grounded: clockwise raises IC1b's gain and lifts the 150 ohm shunt on Q6's collector

controls.label: Low
controls.note: VR2 COLOR MIX 'L' 10 kOhm: clockwise boosts the 87 Hz resonator, counter-clockwise cuts it

controls.label: High
controls.note: VR3 COLOR MIX 'H' 10 kOhm: clockwise boosts the 958 Hz / 1278 Hz resonators, counter-clockwise cuts them

controls.label: Stereo
controls.note: Catalogue stereo parameter; the HM-2 is mono, stored only

parts.label: 9 V rail decoupling series (R10 1k: feeds Q6's R17, Q7's R26/R28)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (520,40,560,90); was missing (the decoupled rail had been merged into 9 V)

parts.label: 9 V rail decoupling (47 uF/16 V, after R10)
Coupling into the bypass switch (1 uF/50 V)
Q4 2SK30A electronic bypass switch, ON (Rds-on)
parts.note: unverified: modelled as its channel resistance because the engine has no 'closed switch' part; the 2SK30A r(on) is a few hundred ohms, so the value only sets a sub-dB insertion loss. The NORMAL branch (Q5/Q2 shunt) is omitted: the effect-on path is the one modelled

parts.label: Q6 base bias to 4.5 V
parts.note: service-notes drawing: base to ground (the stage self-biases through R16 470k)

parts.label: DIST shunt from Q6's collector (R49 150)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (430,190,460,250); BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: R49 150 + C31 10/16 to volume-board pin 7 = VR4 lug 1

parts.label: DIST shunt coupling (C31 10 uF/16 V) to pin 7
Q7 emitter resistor to the R10 rail
Q7 base bias from the R10 rail (R26 100k)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (630,100,660,180) and BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: R26 hangs from the R10/R28 rail to Q7's base. With R29 470k collector-base it biases the PNP's collector near mid-supply (it is the + input bias of IC1b)

parts.label: R25 68k from 9 V to Q7's collector / IC1b pin 5
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (840,130,880,190) and BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: the 9 V arrow is on R25; Q7's collector drives IC1b + directly (no coupling capacitor)

parts.label: Clip diode D5 (anode on pin 7)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (600,120,700,170) at 8x: D4 and D5 both point toward pin 6, i.e. against D3 (they had been wired in D3's direction)

parts.label: IC1b gain leg R42 47k to pin 10 = VR4 lug 3
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (380,260,800,500) at 3.5x and BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: R42 goes to volume-board pin 10, not to ground

parts.label: DIST VR4 250k D: wiper grounded, lug 1 on pin 7 (Q6 shunt), lug 3 on pin 10 (IC1b gain leg)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (380,260,800,500) at 3.5x; BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated volume board: wiper (2) to ground, (1) pin 7, (3) pin 10. Clockwise moves the wiper toward lug 3: IC1b's gain rises (1+220k/(47k+R)) and the 150 ohm shunt on Q6's collector is lifted, so DIST 0 is a quiet, cleaner sound, never silence. Taper: the Boss 'D' law is modelled with the reverse-log C law (unverified)

parts.label: Series clip pair D6 (in line between R23 and R30)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (700,150,780,230) at 3.5x: D6/D7 are an antiparallel pair in series with the signal, not shunts to ground

parts.label: Series clip pair D7 (antiparallel to D6)
Into the IC1a buffer (C15 1 uF/50 V)
COLOR MIX amplifier IC3a (non-inverting, unity at flat)
COLOR MIX L: VR2 10kG, lug 1 on pin 14 (IC3a +), lug 3 on pin 13 (IC3a -), wiper to the low resonator
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (380,260,800,500) at 3.5x and BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: both COLOR MIX pots span pins 14-13; each wiper feeds its own series resonator (pin 16 = low, pin 15 = mid + high). Clockwise (toward IC3a -) boosts the band, counter-clockwise cuts it. Taper 'G' modelled linear (unverified)

parts.label: COLOR MIX H: VR3 10kG across pins 14-13, wiper to the mid + high resonators
Low resonator series C35 1.5 uF (from VR2 wiper)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (470,480,760,720) at 4x: pin 16 -> C35 -> gyrator node; C30 from that node to the follower's +, R47 330 to its output, R51 100k + to 4.5 V. L = 330*100k*0.068u = 2.24 H, f0 = 87 Hz

parts.label: Mid resonator series C28 0.15 uF (from VR3 wiper)
High resonator series C29 0.1 uF (also on VR3's wiper)
Q10 2SK30A electronic output switch, ON (channel resistance)
parts.note: boss-hm2-heavy-metal-schematic.png (850,320,1080,520) at 3x and BOSS_HM-2_SERVICE_NOTES.pdf p.2 @200dpi rotated: Q10 is the output half of the FET bypass pair; the signal runs through its channel (C32/R50 on one side, R48/C7 on the other) and its gate goes to D12 / the flip-flop. Modelled like Q4: the channel's on resistance (unverified: a few hundred ohms at most against 1 Mohm, sub-dB). It was a source follower with the signal on the gate

parts.label: Coupling into the output emitter follower (C7 0.047)
Q3 base return
parts.note: base return to the 4.5 V bias (a return to ground leaves the output device cut off; the drawn value 470k sets Ie ~0.44 mA at hFE 250)

M5218L.note: Mitsubishi M5218L dual op-amp (HM-2 IC1-3): 4558-class - Av 1.5e5, GBW 3 MHz, SR 1 V/us, single 9 V supply, output swing 1.5 V from each rail. unverified: the M5218L datasheet is not to hand; 4558-class typicals used

1S2473.note: Hitachi 1S2473 silicon switching diode: no vendor card found, 1N914 card used (same 0.6-0.7 V class)

1S188FM.note: Toshiba 1S188FM silicon diode: no card found; slightly softer/higher-Rs than 1N914 (unverified), chosen so the anti-series pair clips a little above the 1S2473

S5500.note: Sanken S5500: no card found, 1N914 card used

2SC2240.note: Toshiba 2SC2240 low-noise NPN (HM-2 parts list). unverified: no vendor SPICE card; BF 400 inside the datasheet hFE range 200-700

2SA733.note: stand-in for the HM-2's 2SA970-GR (not in the engine library): NEC 2SA733-P approximate EM set, hFE 200-400 matches the GR grade. unverified

2SC828.note: stand-in for the HM-2's 2SC945-P output device (not in the engine library). unverified

2N5458.note: stand-in for the HM-2's 2SK30A-Y: the engine library's 2N5458 Shichman-Hodges card. unverified: the 2SK30A-Y is a lower-IDSS part, so this model is hotter than the real JFET

2SK30A.note: Toshiba 2SK30A-Y (HM-2 parts list: Q1/Q4/Q5/Q10): Y-grade IDSS 1.2-3.0 mA, VGS(off) -0.8 to -3.0 V; card takes the middle IDSS 2.0 mA / Vp -1.5 V so BETA = IDSS/Vp^2 = 0.889 mA/V^2 and gm0 = 2*IDSS/|Vp| = 2.67 mS. unverified: LAMBDA, IS and the capacitances are datasheet-typical rather than measured
